Immutable admitted feed gates lifecycle. Metadata fetch uses redirect:error. parseUpdateResponse returns raw asset URL and optional digest. downloadAndStage passes those to the existing downloader, then dispatches Windows verifySignature or Squirrel.Mac local-feed staging.

confirmed_findings.fact: URL admission only calls new URL(value). It does not constrain protocol/origin/credentials or bind an asset to the admitted feed. This is a gap after the repaired metadata-source gate, not evidence that any particular foreign host has been contacted.
The artifact request explicitly uses redirect:'follow'. Metadata redirect refusal therefore does not constrain artifact redirects. There is no observed final-URL/source-authority check in this owner.

Windows sha256hash is optional and accepts any nonempty string; no64-hex validation or lowercase canonicalization. macOS branch ignores sha256hash entirely. Downloader hashes only when sha256 is present and compares the lowercase computed hex to the raw supplied string.

HTTP non-success and empty-body errors concatenate options.url verbatim. SandUpdateService.checkForUpdates then writes the message to the log and lastCheck.errorMessage, exposing a signed URL or other sensitive query if present. Fetch/body errors can also escape unnormalized.

The write-stream error listener is attached only when write() returns false; construction/open/early asynchronous errors do not have an unconditional rejection owner. This is a source-level recovery concern requiring a focused behavioral negative, not a locally reproduced crash.

concrete_changes: Define fixed downloader failure messages/codes for HTTP status, missing body, network/read/write failure, abort and digest mismatch. Do not include raw URL, query, username/password, server response text or external error.message in user-visible logs/Settings. Keep status or safe error class where useful.

When a sha256hash is supplied, require exactly64 hexadecimal digits and normalize to lowercase before network or filesystem activity. Carry that declared digest through both iupdate and squirrel parsed offers; macOS must not discard it. Preserve current optional/missing-digest behavior until the mandatory-digest feed contract is explicitly amended, and keep missing digests visibly outside provenance acceptance.

Install a single rejection/cleanup owner for stream open/write/read/finish and cancellation. Delete only this attempted candidate on failure, await cleanup, and preserve any previously staged installer, apply marker and settings. Do not turn an abort into a signature/ready success.

Keep current source16, controlled-publisher28/native11 and original recovery tests, adding behavioral cases through actual SandUpdateService plus the real downloader. Update expected suite count only from the authored named cases, then require actual exact-H Actions counts.
